attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; BigQuery API v2 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the BigQuery API v2, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20260620) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (47 methods, 49 operations) and every Discovery schema (224 components) is modelled. The bigquery adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders. Since 2026-11-16 every method that accepts media also has its Discovery `mediaUpload` URIs as operations of their own (`<method id>.simpleUpload` at /upload/..., `<method id>.resumableUpload` at /resumable/upload/...), which the googleapis SDK really calls for uploads and which the earlier conversion dropped; they hang off rootUrl, so each such path item overrides `servers`. That adds 2 operations (jobs.insert, two protocols).
